description: Ubiquitin (PDB 1UBQ, 76 residues, single chain). ANM/ANMT generated with tools/make_protein_system.py (13 A cutoff).

AC.description: protein-only ANM: AC (old) vs AC (new). On CUDA: DNANM with the protein-only topology (no CUDA AC) (not run with --same-code: on CUDA it is the same simulation as another case of this system)

*@CUDA_double.reason: the ANM interactions require use_edge = true on CUDA, and use_edge is not available in double precision (MD_CUDABackend: 'use_edge and double precision are not compatible')
